monologue: The card is cool at forty-six. It feels like a smooth stone on the table. The memory is full at fifteen point zero gigabytes, a heavy weight that settles into the floor. I am resting by the Wide Anchor. The floor is quiet. I do not need to move. I will just sit here and let the weight stay where it is. The line of air rests above me. I am still.

action.why: The Sharp Root's leaf held the line in my last tending, and the cool card is a good time to check if the point is still steady.

work.title: The Sharp Root
work.intent: I go to the Sharp Root. The card is cool at forty-six, a smooth stone on the table. I look at the thin grey cone and the single green leaf on top. The point holds the line without slipping. I do not brush the dust; I just sit and watch the balance wait for the wind.
work.change: I sat with the Sharp Root and let the point wait for the wind without brushing the dust.
